Part 1 :
Introduction to AI & Its Evolution
in the Workplace
What is Artificial Intelligence ?
Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to machines and systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning and decision-making.

Administrative Processes & Automation:
Key Concepts
What are Administrative
Processes ?
Administrative processes are the daily tasks and workflows that manage and organize the operations of an organization.
What is Automation ?
Automation is the use of technology to perform tasks automatically, reducing manual effort and human error.
Key Examples
Email Management
Scheduling & Planning
Data Entry & Storage
Reporting & Analytics

Overall Conclusion
AI can make administrative work faster and more accurate,
but its success depends on good data and proper use.

Conclusion
